_about: James Burnett, Lord Monboddo (1714-1799): Antient Metaphysics, or the Science of Universals, 6 vols. (Edinburgh: J. Balfour; London: T. Cadell, and later Bell and Bradfute and Cadell and Davies, 1779-1799), raw IA OCR, clean 0.90-0.92. The title pages read 1779 (I), 1782 (II), 1784 (III), 1795 (IV, garbled), 1797 (V); vol. VI's year is not in the OCR and 1799 is taken from the catalogue. Published anonymously. US public domain. No uids minted.
